statements.statement: Since Robin Vos became Speaker of the Wisconsin Assembly in 2013, only one Assembly seat has flipped from Republican to Democrat, which was when Democrat Robyn Vining won the District 14 seat in 2018 previously held by Republican Dale Kooyenga by defeating Republican Matt Adamczyk by 138 votes; the Republican majority in the Assembly has remained largely stable since 2013 with only minor fluctuations, as Republicans held 63 seats after the 2014 election, picked up one in the 2016 election, then dropped back to 63 with Vining’s victory in 2018, and most Democratic victories in the Wisconsin Assembly during this period involved candidates filling seats previously held by other Democrats.
